title: 25 Years of Peace
description: While celebrating the achievements of this historic event, we want to look to the future and think about what it could bring for the country.The Good Friday Agreement’s big success was the reconciliation of the Protestant/ Unionist and Catholic/ Nationalist communities. title: Government Asks Households to Prepare While National Security Strategy Remains Missing
description: The Government is asking Irish families to plan for potential threats. It should also explain what it is doing to prepare the country for them. More than two million Irish households are this week receiving the Government’s Be Emergency Ready booklet, encouraging them to make a plan for emergency situations. Families are advised, for example, to keep adequate supplies of food and water, maintain alternative means of communication and to discuss with neighbours how to manage emergency situations.
